thread:
jamie: Quick update — Tyler submitted resignation today. Last day is 2026-05-08 (Fri). Can we kick off exit clearance + benefits timeline? cc @morgan and @emily

morgan (People Ops): Sorry to hear that. I'll own the offboarding checklist. Need Tyler's personal email for COBRA packet and confirm laptop pickup/dropoff.

emily (People Ops Coordinator): I can schedule the exit interview — two windows: Tue 5/5 10am PT or Thu 5/7 2pm PT. Which works for Tyler?

jamie: He prefers Tue morning. Please send calendar invite to his personal email once we have it.

morgan (People Ops): Noted. COBRA / benefits notes: active coverage ends midnight on last day (2026-05-08). COBRA election window = 60 days after termination. We'll send the COBRA packet to the personal email on file and include health/dental/401k continuation info. Tyler should expect an email from benefits@redwood.com.

sarah (Payroll): Final paycheck: regular payroll run will include final wages + accrued PTO payout on the next monthly cycle (pay date 2026-05-31). If Tyler has expense claims, ask him to file by EOD 5/10 to ensure inclusion. Also confirm 401k distribution paperwork timing?

jamie: FYI Tyler has one outstanding expense (~$120 Uber) and a contractor invoice to wrap. I'll ping the vendor owner.

alex (IT): Access removal plan (propose):
- disable Okta + Slack at 6pm PT on 2026-05-08
- remove GitHub org membership and ECR/EKS IAM at same time
- revoke AWS console keys immediately upon disable; rotate any shared keys
- schedule laptop pickup with ops for 5/9 or provide return shipping label
Commands I will run: `okta deactivate-user tyler@redwood.com` and `gh org remove-member tyler`

devon (Security): Please audit service accounts Tyler owns before disabling. Tag any secrets in vault with `owner=tyler` and we'll reassign. If Tyler has VPN certs or SSH keys, revoke ASAP.

alex (IT): Good call — can someone list repo/service ownerships? Jamie?

jamie: Tyler is primary on `realtime-ingest`, `decoder-serving`, and `billing-hooks`. I'll make a short ownership transfer doc by EOD today.

emily (People Ops Coordinator): Tyler's personal email is tyler.rivera.personal@gmail.com (confirmed). Sending COBRA packet and exit interview invite for Tue 5/5 10am PT now.

morgan (People Ops): Sending checklist and timeline to thread: 
- 5/05: exit interview 10am PT
- 5/08: last day, benefits end at 11:59pm PT
- 5/08 18:00 PT: disable Okta/Slack/GitHub (as Alex specified)
- 5/09: laptop pickup / return label shipped if remote
- 5/31: final payroll run includes PTO + final wages
- COBRA: packet within 3 business days after termination

sarah (Payroll): Confirmed on payroll timing. If Tyler opts into COBRA, premiums billed to his chosen payment method; HR will provide cost estimates.

devon (Security): I'll run an owner audit on infra tonight and post a list of keys/certs that need revocation. Expect that in ~3 hours.

alex (IT): Also: two-factor devices — ask Tyler to surrender company YubiKey (if issued) at handoff or return in laptop box.

jamie: Tyler has one YubiKey yes. I'll collect it during knowledge transfer.

emily (People Ops Coordinator): Quick checklist item for Tyler: please complete the equipment return form here: https://forms.internal/asset-return (fills auto-create ticket). offboard-bot: reminder?

offboard-bot: Reminder scheduled — submit equipment return form and sign exit form. Due: 2026-05-08.

morgan (People Ops): One more: manager approval to publish a brief team note about his departure? Keep it light, outline knowledge transfer plan and PM for questions. Jamie ok to draft?

jamie: I'll draft a short note and run it by People Ops before posting.

alex (IT): For timing: I will coordinate with Security to disable accounts at 18:00 PT on 5/08. If any of you need pre-disable access to repo data, let me know before 5/07 so we can snapshot.

devon (Security): Snapshot logs for Tyler's activity will be archived 30 days. If compliance needs data retention >30d, escalate to legal.

morgan (People Ops): Thanks all — I'm tracking these tasks in the exit tracker and will update thread as things move. :thumbsup:

emily (People Ops Coordinator): Sent calendar invites and COBRA notification email just now. Tyler acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

sarah (Payroll): Payroll sent final paycheck estimate to Tyler's personal email for review.

jamie: Appreciate the quick responses. If anything blocks the timeline, flag here or DM me.

morgan (People Ops): Closing loop later today with final owner handoffs and the equipment ticket #RX-4127.

offboard-bot: Equipment ticket RX-4127 created for Tyler Rivera.

emily (People Ops Coordinator): All set from my side. Thanks team.

jamie: TY all.
